name: Kingdom of Miscellania
description: Throne of Miscellania and Royal Trouble to run the kingdom with 15 workers

children.note: Raise the people's support from 25% to 75% during the quest. Completing it opens Managing Miscellania with 10 workers.
15 workers instead of 10, 50% more output, a coffer of up to 7.5m and a daily wage of up to 75k.

children.title: Fill the coffers
children.note: Each day 10% of the coffer is paid in wages, at most 75k after Royal Trouble. The wiki suggests keeping at least 750k in it.

children.title: Keep approval up
children.note: Approval falls 1% a day after Royal Trouble (2.5% before). Raise it by working on the islands.
